text:
You need an application that generates sales copy and a webpage using APIs from OpenAI, Eleven Labs, and a hosted Stable Diffusion setup.

I’m Noor Halden, a developer with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas. I’ve built similar AI-powered systems, including a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and improved clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. I also built a delivery support chatbot that tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with context, with 43% of conversations resolved without an agent.

I’d be glad to help build this product and work with your team long term.
